derivation: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2192 (ἔχω);
def: to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel

occurrences.text: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
